calibration.note: Counted legs with a nightly graded band on file, Oct 24 → Nov 15. Legs on void tickets are not counted legs and never enter the denominator; legs with no final (void legs on counted tickets) are excluded and counted separately.

bloodline.definition: ON FIRE = narrative_20261024.py tiers v1: last 10 PLAYED games (MIN>0) before the night, in-band rate >= 0.80 AND trailing in-band streak >= 3 vs that night's graded input_band (window_n < 5 -> STEADY). A stack is an entry game (a game on that night's delivered tickets) carrying two or more DISTINCT ON FIRE (player, category) pairs among that night's DELIVERED-TICKET legs. Pool-wide counting is rejected: ~38% of graded player-categories are ON FIRE, so it stacks 119 of 129 entry-games and says nothing. A stack is a game-environment signal, not a ticket.
